messages:
noah: Alert — since ~09:23 UTC we've observed incident-bot suppressing outbound pages to the external pager provider; multiple customers reported missed pages :rotating_light:
ops-bot: automated: incident-bot auto-escalation paused for integration `pager-external` due to repeated 422 responses. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/pager-integration
sre-oncall: I'm taking this. Switching to manual paging fallback now. If you need direct pages, DM me numbers.
leila: Quick question: which failure mode? webhook signing, header rewrite, or payload validation?
maria: FYI one customer (acct: acme-co) missed 4 pages between 09:24-09:31 UTC and opened a support ticket.
samir: Initial signal: our pager-proxy began returning 422s right after the proxy cert/key rotation at ~09:19 UTC and a small proxy change went out in deploy abc123.
noah: Rolling logs now, snippet shows missing signature header causing downstream validation failure:
```
2026-03-20T09:23:12Z sendFanout request_id=bf34ca status=422 body={"error":"invalid-recipient","detail":"missing-x-pager-signature"}
handler.go: fanout aborted: downstream 422
```
samir: Repro: proxy was dropping `X-Pager-Signature` when request body >2kb due to an old buffer edge-case from branch B. Looks like regression introduced in abc123.
leila: Runbook step 2: if fanout returns persistent client errors, switch incbot to passthrough and enable verbose logs.
noah: Applying mitigation now:
```
/incbot mode passthrough --reason "proxy header strip after rotation"
/incbot set-log-level debug --target pager-proxy
```
ops-bot: acknowledged: manual paging enabled; auto-escalation suppressed. Ops will notify on resume.
sre-oncall: Confirming manual pages are flowing. I just sent an SMS to acme-co and they confirmed receipt. Marking customer impact = moderate.
maria: I'm drafting customer comms + updating the support ticket with timeline and temporary workaround. CC: @support-lead.
samir: Hotfix: reverting proxy change from abc123 -> abc122. Patch build `proxy-fix-832` ready. Plan: canary 10% -> observe -> rollout.
noah: Heads-up: watch for duplicates when we unpause auto-escalation. Avoid flooding external oncall.
leila: I'll insert a 5m dedupe window on the fanout edge before we re-enable auto-escalation.
sre-oncall: Starting safety canary (10%) for proxy-fix-832. Will verify 422s go away.
ops-bot: canary deploy started by @samir. Will post outcome.
samir: Canary finished, headers preserved, downstream acked. Sample success log:
```
2026-03-20T09:41:02Z sendFanout request_id=bf37ff status=200 body={"ok":true,"id":"pg_98765"}
```
noah: Good. Re-enabling auto-escalation in 2m with dedupe window active.
ops-bot: auto-escalation resume scheduled by @noah in 2m; will alert on >3xx/4xx spike.
sre-oncall: Auto-escalation re-enabled. Monitoring shows normal fanout and no 422 spikes for 15m. Closing live mitigation channel.
maria: Customer notes sent, support ticket updated with timeline and RCA stub. Thanks team :tada:
noah: Follow-ups: 1) add header-preservation tests in proxy CI, 2) add synthetic E2E paging check in prod every 5m -> alert on 4xx/5xx rate, 3) postmortem scheduled at 14:00 UTC.
leila: I'll own the synthetic check and schedule the postmortem invite.
sre-oncall: End of thread — incident mitigated, manual fallback used and customer impact tracked. Great coordination.
